name: palette
caption: The shared colour vocabulary used on every axis of this notebook: each swatch names the prior, data source, literature overlay or annotation it marks.

name: sweep_map
caption: Final development R² of every LGD arm as a heatmap, one row per configuration grouped by credit fraction and one column per seed; hatched cells are arms still training, annotated with the share trained.

name: monitoring_coverage
caption: Monitoring coverage of every LGD arm: one row per real dataset labelled development or holdout, one column per arm in sweep order, cells coloured by whether the dataset enters the development mean, is holdout, is missing or was not monitored.

name: throughput
caption: Training speed per LGD arm in steps per second (left) and the implied hours for the full run (right), grouped by freeze strategy; points are arms coloured by credit fraction and bars are group medians.

name: training_loss
caption: Training loss against optimisation step for every LGD arm (grey), the mean of the finished arms (black), and the best and worst arms by final development R² (highlighted).

name: gradient_flow
caption: Mean per-block gradient L2 norm (column encoder, row encoder, ICL blocks, head) against training step on a logarithmic axis.

name: weight_gradient_ratios
caption: Mean per-block ratio of gradient norm to weight norm against training step on a logarithmic axis, one line per architecture block.

name: metric_over_training
caption: Development R² averaged over the development datasets every arm carries, against training step; one line per arm coloured by credit fraction, dotted while unfinished, with the mean of the finished arms in black.

name: credit_vs_control_over_training
caption: Development R² against training step for credit-prior arms versus control arms: median lines with shaded inter-quartile bands across the finished arms in each group.

name: metric_by_lever_credit_fraction
caption: Development R² against training step, one mean line per value of credit fraction, averaged over the finished arms that share each value.

name: metric_by_lever_strategy
caption: Development R² against training step, one mean line per value of freeze strategy, averaged over the finished arms that share each value.

name: metric_by_lever_l2sp
caption: Development R² against training step, one mean line per value of L2-SP, averaged over the finished arms that share each value.

name: metric_by_lever_lr
caption: Development R² against training step, one mean line per value of learning rate, averaged over the finished arms that share each value.

name: real_vs_ood
caption: Development R² on the real-credit datasets (solid) and the out-of-domain suites (dashed) against training step, averaged separately over credit-prior and control arms.

name: final_metric_by_lever
caption: Final development R² of every finished arm as points coloured by credit fraction, one panel per swept lever, with a horizontal bar at each group mean.

name: lever_interaction
caption: Final development R² against each lever other than credit fraction, one series per credit fraction: points are finished arms, lines join the per-value means and whiskers show one standard deviation over seeds; the grey band is the control mean plus or minus one standard deviation.

name: per_dataset_p1
caption: Monitored R² against training step, one panel per real dataset labelled with its role, credit arms (blue) against control arms (grey); holdout datasets are shown but never averaged.

name: eval_metrics_p1
caption: Each logged development metric against training step, one panel per metric, credit-prior (blue) and control (grey) means over the finished arms; the arrow in each title marks the improving direction.

name: per_config_p1
caption: Per-arm training curves against step in sweep-map order: train loss (grey) and development R² (blue, right axis), one panel per arm, unfinished arms labelled with the share trained.

name: best_and_worst
caption: Train loss and development R² against training step for the best and worst finished arm by final development R².

name: hardware
caption: GPU utilisation, throughput and peak allocated memory against training step, pooled across arms; the dashed line marks 70 percent utilisation.
